summary: AI Comment Generator web application with dark-themed dashboard, comment length selection, smart generation system, 3D rotating cube, and polished UI with smooth animations
architectural_notes: React + TypeScript frontend with Vite bundler
Motoko backend on Internet Computer platform
Frontend-based comment generation using templates and randomization
CSS 3D transforms for rotating cube (no WebGL/Three.js)
Dark theme with purple/pink gradient color scheme

existing_features.title: Add comment length selection dropdown to AiCommentGenerator component with three options: Short (50-100 words), Medium (100-200 words), and Long (200-300 words). Pass the selected length to the generation logic.

Enhance the comment generation algorithm in AiCommentGenerator to guarantee completely fresh, unique comments on every generation. Use randomized sentence structures, varied vocabulary pools, dynamic adjectives, and timestamp-based seeding to prevent any duplicate outputs. Integrate the rating symbol naturally into the generated text.

Fix the list visibility glitch in AiCommentTable so that generated comments appear instantly and correctly below the generation card as soon as the user clicks 'Generate'. Ensure proper state management and DOM updates.

Implement a skeleton loader in AiCommentTable that displays while comments are being generated. Add a smooth typing effect animation that reveals each comment character-by-character after it's fetched to create a real-time streaming appearance.

Create a lightweight 3D rotating cube using pure CSS 3D transforms and integrate it into the AdminPanel AI Comments tab. Position it strategically to complement the dark theme and purple/pink gradients without cluttering the form area. The cube should rotate continuously and smoothly.

Optimize the loading speed of AiCommentGenerator component by ensuring all async operations (comment generation, API calls) don't block the main thread. Use proper React Query hooks with optimistic updates and ensure mutations complete efficiently.

Polish the UI of AiCommentGenerator and AiCommentTable with smooth hover states, proper spacing, clean transitions, and modern styling. Keep the existing dark theme with purple/pink gradients but enhance button interactions, input focus states, and card shadows for a snappier, more modern feel.
